title: Page 4
content_zh:
母亲坚信不移的“真爱”根本不堪一击，多情的父亲早忘了她是谁，那提起母亲姓名时的陌生他怎么会看不出来？

和母亲分开后，父亲过得很好，他爱上了别人，娶了年轻貌美的妻子，过着幸福快乐的日子。

眼泪早在母亲抵抗病魔期间流干了，此刻的文景瑞哭不出来，他瞪着文渊华以及他身旁的女人，等两人相亲相爱完之后跟着他们回家。

路上，文景瑞不发一语，静静地听着继母和父亲说话，嘴角讥诮地上扬。

从对话中他得知他们新婚不到半年，继母姓温，叫温雅，与文家是世交，青梅竹马的两人本来没有太多交集，却突然在数月前一见钟情，迅速坠入爱河，交往两个月后便闪电结婚。

“景瑞，你这时候来我们家真是太好了！”温雅热情地从副驾驶座回头，朝后座的他嫣然一笑。“这么一来琳琳就有伴了。”

“对耶！”文渊华经妻子一提，才想起了这件好事。“雅雅，这样我们下个月去捷克玩，就不用担心琳琳一个人在家了。”

“是不是！不然老送去我爸那里真的很麻烦。”温雅兴奋地回应完丈夫，又回过头，微笑着对他说道：“景瑞，琳琳很乖，不会惹麻烦，你只要晚上回来给她吃东西就好了，你是哥哥，没有问题吧？”语气根本不是在征求他的同意，而是直接做决定。

文景瑞想，继母要托付的或许是小狗、小猫之类的宠物吧，也就点了点头，随着父亲以及继母来到一栋高楼大厦。

“琳琳，妈咪回来了，快出来！”甫一进门，温雅便对着房子高喊，口吻十分亲昵。

文景瑞站在玄关，为眼前窗明几净的客厅感到错愕不已。

这是他在电视上才会看见的装潢，白色的沙发、深色的榉木地板，明亮又气氛佳的黄色灯光，通风良好的客厅……跟他与母亲住了十几年，那个小小的、简陋的铁皮屋简直差了十万八千里。

在他跟母亲挨饿受冻的时候，父亲就住在这么漂亮舒适的房子里……

“琳琳，你在哪里呀？”温雅在客厅里的高声呼唤，打断了文景瑞内心复杂的比较。

“妈咪。”一个微弱的声音伴随一张带着羞涩笑容的小脸，出现在客厅。

“琳琳，你跑去哪里了！”温雅娇声抱怨着。“不是叫你不要乱跑吗？你去哪里了 ”她稍嫌粗鲁的拉过小女孩的手臂。

琳琳不是宠物，而是个小女孩吗？！文景瑞为这不在预期中的发展呆了呆，这小女孩叫温雅“妈咪”，那——

“妈咪跟叔叔出去的时候我只能在房间呀，我没有出去。”小女孩笑着，语气却透露着小心翼翼，还有点别的、他不懂的东西。

“这么乖呀？好吧，你看，这是渊华叔叔的儿子，以后我们就是一家人了，你叫他阿瑞哥哥吧。”温雅将女儿拉到文景瑞面前，兴奋地介绍。

叔叔？不是爸爸？这么说来这女孩不是爸爸的女儿喽。文景瑞心想。

“阿瑞，你也见见琳琳，我跟你雅姨会常常不在家，以后家里就你们两人，她年纪小，你要多照顾她。”文渊华先转头对甫相认的儿子说道，接着再对小女孩说：“琳琳，以后有哥哥陪你玩，开不开心？”

小女孩看了看突然出现在家里的陌生少年，防备地瑟缩了下，神情有些僵硬，却还是点了点头，笑着说：“嗯，开心。”

“琳琳好乖，对了，叔叔有买史努比给你喔。”文渊华转头寻找刚买的礼物，一找才发现东西还放在车上。“在车上，叔叔去拿，你等一等。”

“什么？！你买礼物给琳琳却没有买给我？”温雅听见丈夫对女儿这么好，噘嘴吃醋抱怨。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

“我也接受了你突然冒出来一个十四岁的儿子啊，又不只有你会爱屋及乌！”

任性的娇娇女一定要争赢。

“好好好，我知道你最爱我了。”

夫妻俩旁若无人地说起了甜蜜的情话，一抱着便不放手，这甜蜜的氛围让文景瑞眼神转暗，神情冰冷。

深信着父亲跟自己之间有着坚贞爱情的母亲尚未下葬，遗体还放在医院没领回，因为他负担不起母亲的丧葬费，他的父亲从见面到现在没问过母亲的事一句，也没有想要去看她一眼，而是开心的在温暖舒适的房子里，搂着年轻貌美的新婚妻子情话绵绵，他对生下他孩子的女人离世完全不感到难过，一点点都没有。

什么叫“会很高兴有他”？这家伙根本就不在乎多了个儿子，他满心满眼只有新婚的妻子！

愤怒和怨恨无法抑制地爬上文景瑞的面容，他瞪着眼前甜蜜放闪的夫妻，更瞪向被他们疼爱着的小女孩。

可当他的眼神扫过那个叫琳琳的小女孩时，发现她虽然努力维持着脸上的笑容，却仍流露出了明显的局促不安。

许是感觉到了他的视线，琳琳回头，发现他在瞪自己，她瑟缩了一下，还是鼓起勇气喊了他一声，“哥哥。”

那一声哥哥有期待、害怕，也有着小心翼翼，喊完她还去看母亲，发现母亲没回头看她，眼神不由得暗了下来。

文景瑞见状才明白，这个小女孩虽然跟母亲住在这里，还有看似疼爱她的继父，却一直觉得自己是局外人。

他懂这种感觉。

出生至今，他总算见到了亲生父亲，并来到父亲身边，可他觉得自己也是个局外人。

他们都一样。

突如其来的恶心感令温希琳蹲下身，靠着马厩角落吐了起来。“呕……”

她吐出来的全是黄色的酸水，没有半点食物，温希琳这才想起来，她已经很久没有进食了。

上次吃东西是什么时候？前天妹妹突然休克送医，到现在仍在昏迷中，她忙得团团转，根本没有时间坐下来吃东西。

啊，是了，上一次吃东西是妹妹比赛前，跟妹妹一起吃的面包……难怪她什么都吐不出来，经过那么长的时间，早就消化光了。

“呕……”恶心感仍未平复，温希琳继续吐着胃中翻搅不已的酸水，散落在颊边的发丝沾染到了秽物，她连忙翻找包包中的卫生纸，同时也想将颊边的头发拨到身后，整个人手忙脚乱。

“拿着。”

折迭成四四方方的干净手帕递到她手边，感觉到散落的头发被人轻柔地拢起，接着是属于男人的手掌在她背上轻拍。

温希琳已经不记得多久没有在自己不舒服、生病时，被人这样关怀，许是心里大受感动，抚平了生理上的不适，恶心的感觉渐渐消失，她不再吐了。

接过干净的手帕擦了擦嘴角，还未来得及对照顾她的文景瑞道谢，一瓶未拆封的矿泉水就递到她手边。

“漱个口吧。”文景瑞在她开始呕吐后便招来在马场工作的员工，要了瓶矿泉水，好让她清理自己。

“谢谢。”温希琳感动于他的体贴，微微一笑。景瑞哥哥还是跟以前一样，看起来很冷淡，其实是个温柔的人呢。

快速地漱了口，她用手帕按压嘴角，想要快速站起来，表现出没事的模样，不想让自己在他面前虚弱狼狈，没想到眼前蓦地一黑，晕眩感迅速来袭，眼看就要倒下……

“你低血糖的毛病一点都没有改善吗？”文景瑞皱眉伸手扶住快要倒下的她，口气不是很愉悦，眼睛再瞟到马废边缘，那一滩只有酸水，没有任何固体残渣的呕吐物。
content_en:
The "true love" that the mother firmly believed in was simply vulnerable. The passionate father had long forgotten who she was, so why couldn't he see the strangeness in his mother's name when he mentioned it?

After separating from his mother, his father lived a good life. He fell in love with someone else, married a young and beautiful wife, and lived a happy life.

The tears had already dried up when his mother was fighting the disease. At this moment, Wen Jingrui couldn't cry. He stared at Wen Yuanhua and the woman beside him, waiting for the two to finish making love and follow them home.

On the way, Wen Jingrui didn't say a word, quietly listening to his stepmother and father talking, the corner of his mouth raised sarcastically.

From the conversation, he learned that they had been married for less than half a year. Their stepmother's surname was Wen, and her name was Wen Ya. She was a family friend of the Wen family. The two childhood sweethearts had not had much contact with each other before, but they suddenly fell in love at first sight a few months ago and quickly fell in love. After dating for two months, they got married in a flash.

"Jingrui, it's great that you came to our house at this time!" Wen Ya turned back from the passenger seat enthusiastically and smiled brightly at him in the back seat."This way Linlin will have company."

"Yes!" Wen Yuanhua's wife mentioned it and remembered this good thing."Yaya, this way we don't have to worry about Linlin being at home alone when we go to the Czech Republic next month."

"Really! Otherwise it would be really troublesome to send her to my dad's place all the time." After Wen Ya responded to her husband excitedly, she turned around and said to him with a smile: "Jingrui, Linlin is very good and won't get into trouble. You just need to come back and give her something to eat at night. You are my brother, is there no problem?" Her tone was not asking for his consent at all, but making a decision directly.

Wen Jingrui thought that his stepmother might be entrusting pets such as puppies and kittens, so he nodded and followed his father and stepmother to a high-rise building.

"Linlin, Mommy is back, come out quickly!" As soon as she entered the door, Wen Ya shouted to the house in a very affectionate tone.

Wen Jingrui stood in the entrance hall, astonished by the bright and clean living room in front of him.

This was a decoration he had only seen on TV, with white sofas, dark beech floors, bright and atmospheric yellow lights, and a well-ventilated living room... The small, simple iron house where he and his mother had lived for more than ten years was completely different.

When he and his mother were starving and freezing, his father lived in such a beautiful and comfortable house...

"Linlin, where are you?" Wen Ya called loudly in the living room, interrupting Wen Jingrui's complicated inner comparison.

"Mommy." A weak voice accompanied by a small face with a shy smile appeared in the living room.

"Linlin, where have you gone?" Wen Ya complained softly."Didn't I tell you not to run around? Where have you been?" She pulled the little girl's arm a little rudely.

Is Linlin not a pet, but a little girl?!Wen Jingrui was stunned by this unexpected development. The little girl called Wen Ya "Mommy", so——

"I could only stay in the room when mommy and uncle went out. I didn't go out." The little girl smiled, but her tone revealed that she was cautious, and there was something else that he didn't understand.

"So good? Well, look, this is Uncle Yuanhua's son. We will be a family from now on. You can call him Brother Ari." Wen Ya pulled her daughter to Wen Jingrui and introduced her excitedly.

uncle?Not dad?So this girl is not her father's daughter.Wen Jingrui thought to himself.

"Arui, please meet Linlin too. Your Aunt Ya and I will often be away from home. From now on, it will be just the two of you at home. She is young, so you should take more care of her." Wen Yuanhua first turned to his son, whom he had just met, and then said to the little girl: "Linlin, are you happy to have your brother to play with you in the future?"

The little girl looked at the strange boy who suddenly appeared at home, and shrank defensively. Her expression was a little stiff, but she still nodded and said with a smile: "Well, I'm happy."

"Linlin is so good. By the way, uncle bought Snoopy for you." Wen Yuanhua turned around to look for the gift he just bought, only to find that it was still in the car."In the car, uncle will go get it. Just wait."

"What?! You bought a gift for Linlin but not for me?" Wen Ya pursed her lips and complained in jealousy when she heard that her husband was so kind to her daughter.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

"I also accept that you suddenly have a fourteen-year-old son. You are not the only one who loves Wujiwu!"

The willful and charming girl must fight to win.

"Okay, okay, I know you love me the most."

The couple spoke sweet words of love as if no one was watching, and never let go once they hugged each other. This sweet atmosphere made Wen Jingrui's eyes darken and his expression became cold.

His mother, who firmly believed in the steadfast love between his father and him, has not yet been buried, and his body is still in the hospital and has not been collected because he cannot afford the funeral expenses for his mother. His father has not asked about his mother since they met, nor has he wanted to see her. Instead, he is happily in a warm and comfortable house, hugging his young and beautiful newlywed wife and talking sweetly. He does not feel sad at all about the death of the woman who gave birth to his child, not at all.

What does "I'd be happy to have him" mean?This guy doesn't care about having another son at all, he only has eyes for his newlywed wife!

Anger and resentment could not be suppressed and crawled onto Wen Jingrui's face. He stared at the sweet couple in front of him, and even more at the little girl who was loved by them.

But when his eyes swept over the little girl named Linlin, he found that although she tried hard to maintain a smile on her face, she still showed obvious embarrassment.

Perhaps sensing his gaze, Linlin turned around and found that he was glaring at her. She flinched, but she mustered up the courage to call him, "Brother."

There was expectation, fear, and caution in that voice. After calling her, she went to look at her mother, but found that her mother did not look back at her, and her eyes darkened involuntarily.

When Wen Jingrui saw this, he realized that although this little girl lived here with her mother and had a stepfather who seemed to love her, she always felt like an outsider.

He knows this feeling.

Since his birth, he finally met his biological father and came to his side, but he felt that he was also an outsider.

They are all the same.

The sudden nausea caused Wen Xilin to squat down and lean against the corner of the stable to vomit."Ugh..."

All she vomited was yellow sour water without any food. Only then did Wen Xilin remember that she hadn't eaten for a long time.

When was the last time you ate?The day before yesterday, my sister suddenly went into shock and was sent to the hospital. She is still in a coma. She is so busy that she has no time to sit down and eat.

Ah, yes, the last time she ate was the bread she ate with her sister before her competition... No wonder she couldn't spit out anything. After such a long time, it had already been digested.

"Ugh..." The nausea has not subsided, Wen Xilin continued to vomit the acidic water that was churning in her stomach, and the hair scattered on her cheeks was contaminated with filth. She hurriedly searched for toilet paper in her bag, and at the same time she wanted to push the hair on her cheeks behind her, and she was in a panic.

"Take it."

A clean handkerchief folded into a square was handed to her hand. She felt her scattered hair being gently gathered up, and then a man's palm patted her back.

Wen Xilin couldn't remember how long it had been since someone had cared for her like this when she was feeling uncomfortable or sick. Xu was deeply moved and the physical discomfort was relieved. The nausea gradually disappeared and she stopped vomiting.

She took a clean handkerchief and wiped the corners of her mouth. Before she could thank Wen Jingrui for taking care of her, an unopened bottle of mineral water was handed to her.

"Rinse your mouth." After she started vomiting, Wen Jingrui called the employees working at the racecourse and asked for a bottle of mineral water so that she could clean herself up.

"Thank you." Wen Xilin was moved by his thoughtfulness and smiled slightly.Brother Jingrui is still the same as before, he looks very cold, but he is actually a gentle person.

Rinsing her mouth quickly, she pressed the corner of her mouth with a handkerchief, trying to stand up quickly and show that she was okay, not wanting to make herself weak and embarrassed in front of him. Unexpectedly, her eyes suddenly darkened, and she felt dizzy quickly, and she was about to fall down...

"Has your hypoglycemia not improved at all?" Wen Jingrui frowned and stretched out his hand to support her who was about to collapse. His tone was not very pleasant, and his eyes glanced at the edge of the horse's body. There was only acidic water in the puddle of vomit without any solid residue.
